method: All 2,353 weights and biases included, activation slope fixed. PCA fitted to 199 checkpoints nearest 200 uniformly spaced training steps; all 500 checkpoints projected onto its top two axes. Plane origin is final weights. No retraining or parameter normalization. Grid samples the full models in this plane.
limits: The trajectory is a projection, not the actual path within this plane. Its contour colors describe projected models, not the original checkpoint losses. The right panel evaluates original checkpoints on the same fixed 4,096 training samples. This training subset is not held-out data. First saved step 1 is before its update.
